column2:
# 引导的是完整发行版：盘就是镜像本身（GPT：p1 rootfs ext4、p15 ESP）。内核、initrd、
  # root=PARTUUID 全在镜像自带的 grub.cfg 里，由 GRUB 自己解析 —— 脚本不必在宿主侧读 ext4。
  # 又慢又安静：README 实测整条链约 18.2B 条指令 / 约 3.9 小时，且 cmdline 带 quiet，
  # 到 login: 之前几乎没有输出，别当成卡死。
  # --timebase 100000000 是必需的：默认 10 MHz 下 10M 指令就是一虚拟秒，systemd 会按
  # 虚拟时间冤杀慢任务，serial-getty 起不来。
column3:
# Boots a complete distribution: the disk is the image itself (GPT: p1 rootfs ext4, p15 ESP).
  # Kernel, initrd and root=PARTUUID live in the image's own grub.cfg, parsed by GRUB, so the
  # script never reads ext4 on the host. Slow and quiet: the README measured ~18.2B instructions
  # / ~3.9 hours, and the cmdline carries quiet, so expect almost no output before login: —
  # that is not a hang. --timebase 100000000 is required: at 10 MHz one virtual second is 10M
  # instructions and systemd kills slow tasks on virtual time, so serial-getty never comes up.

column2: # 必须带 earlycon=sbi：Alpine 内核编了 SBI earlycon 驱动，有它约 150M 指令内\n  # 就能看到输出；没有它内核会把 printk 攒在 ring buffer 里，直到 16550 控制台\n  # 注册（约 350-400M 指令）才一次性倒出 —— 看起来像卡死。
column3:
# Always pass earlycon=sbi: the Alpine kernel has the SBI earlycon driver, and with
  # it you see output within about 150M instructions. Without it the kernel buffers
  # printk until the 16550 console registers (350-400M instructions) and then dumps
  # everything at once, which looks exactly like a hang.

column2:
# 用的是未压缩的 initramfs.cpio：内核认不出压缩就直接按裸 cpio 用，
  # 省掉在模拟器里跑 inflate。同机同核实测（两条路都到 shell）：
  #   initramfs.cpio.gz   1,270,638,213 条指令   到 /init 用 t=120.26s
  #   initramfs.cpio        776,011,912 条指令   到 /init 用 t=64.67s
  # 省 4.95 亿条（38.9%）。差别不是能不能起来，是快多少。
  # （虚拟秒与指令数不成正比：内核的 time 走被抖动的 mtime，指令数才是准的。）
column3:
# This run booted the uncompressed initramfs.cpio: the kernel does not recognise a
compression format and uses the archive as a plain cpio, skipping the inflate pass.
Measured on one machine with one kernel (both reach a shell):
  initramfs.cpio.gz   1,270,638,213 instructions, /init at t=120.26s
  initramfs.cpio        776,011,912 instructions, /init at t=64.67s
That is 495M instructions, 38.9%. The difference is speed, not whether it boots.
(Virtual seconds are not proportional to instructions: the kernel's time comes from a
jittered mtime. Trust instret.)

column2:
用法:
  npx tsx tools/mkfat.ts <out.img> [--size=BYTES] [--part-type=0x0C] [--label=TSIE] NAME=HOSTPATH [NAME=HOSTPATH ...]

  NAME        镜像内的路径，'/' 分隔，允许前导 '/'；中间目录会自动创建
  HOSTPATH    宿主机上的文件，必须存在
  --size      镜像总字节数（可带 K/M/G 后缀，1M = 1 MiB）；省略时自动：
              文件总字节 + 2 MiB 余量，向上取整到整 MiB
  --part-type MBR 分区类型字节，默认 0x0C（FAT16 LBA）；EDK II 的 ESP 传 0xEF
  --label     卷标，最长 11 个字符，默认 TSIE

磁盘布局: 扇区 0 是 MBR，分区从 LBA 2048（1 MiB 对齐）起；卷内 512 字节/扇区、
  2 份 FAT、保留 1 扇区、根目录固定 512 项。簇大小自动挑：从 64 KiB 往下取第一个
  让簇数仍 ≥ 4085 的值 —— 簇数低于 4085 时固件会按 FAT12 去解 12 位的 FAT 链。
确定性: DOS 时间戳固定为 2026-01-01 00:00:00，卷序列号由卷标/卷扇区数/簇大小派生，
  同样的输入两次构建得到逐字节相同的镜像。
column3:
Usage:
  npx tsx tools/mkfat.ts <out.img> [--size=BYTES] [--part-type=0x0C] [--label=TSIE] NAME=HOSTPATH [NAME=HOSTPATH ...]

  NAME        path inside the image, '/'-separated; a leading '/' is allowed and
              intermediate directories are created automatically
  HOSTPATH    a file on the host; it must exist
  --size      total image size in bytes (K/M/G suffixes accepted, 1M = 1 MiB).
              Omitted: sum of file sizes + 2 MiB slack, rounded up to a whole MiB
  --part-type MBR partition type byte, default 0x0C (FAT16 LBA); pass 0xEF for an EDK II ESP
  --label     volume label, at most 11 characters, default TSIE

Disk layout: sector 0 is the MBR and the partition starts at LBA 2048 (1 MiB aligned);
  inside the volume: 512-byte sectors, two FATs, one reserved sector, a fixed 512-entry
  root directory. The cluster size is picked automatically: the largest value from 64 KiB
  down that still leaves at least 4085 clusters, because below 4085 clusters firmware
  parses the 12-bit FAT chain instead.
Deterministic: DOS timestamps are fixed at 2026-01-01 00:00:00 and the volume serial is
  derived from the label, volume sectors and cluster size, so the same input yields the
  same bytes on every run.

  # and hands over with booti. That is the whole difference from the direct path: the
  # kernel is not placed by the firmware, the bootloader loads it.
  # uboot-cmd.txt is generated for you; edit it to change the boot behaviour.

# With nothing bootable the firmware falls back to its own UEFI Shell, which runs
